tool_signatures.name: get_decisions_for_context
tool_signatures.description: Fetch the team's canonical engineering decisions for a file/area and task.

file_path_or_area.description: The file path, directory, or architectural area you are about to work in (e.g. "src/routes/api/users.py" or "billing").

task_description.description: A short description of what you are about to do there (e.g. "add error handling to the billing webhook").

parameters.name: task_description

scope.description: The subsystem/scope you are about to verify or work in (e.g. "services/auth"). Contracts relevant to it are returned.

tags.description: Optional check tags to narrow by (e.g. ["smoke", "critical-path"]).

tool_signatures.name: submit_candidate_decision
tool_signatures.description: Record a new engineering convention you discovered while working — for human review.

pattern.description: The concrete rule or guideline, stated imperatively (e.g. "Use internal.http for outbound calls, not the requests library").

scope.description: Where the rule applies: a file path, directory/glob, or architectural layer (e.g. "src/services/**"), or "global".

rationale.description: Why the convention exists — the problem or bug it prevents (e.g. "flaky network caused phantom 5xx errors; the internal client retries").

confidence.description: How strongly the team holds this convention.

keywords.description: Optional: 3-8 retrieval terms an engineer might use when describing a task this rule applies to — synonyms and code identifiers not already in the pattern wording (e.g. ["s3", "presigned", "upload"]).

tool_signatures.name: submit_feedback
tool_signatures.description: Report how helpful the served decisions were, and what was missing.

query_id.description: The `query_id` token from the get_decisions_for_context output you are responding to.

helpful.description: Optional shorthand: 1-based indices of decisions that helped. Usually derived from `ratings`, so prefer `ratings`.

unhelpful.description: Optional shorthand: 1-based indices of decisions that were noise or misleading.

ratings.description: The main signal: map of 1-based decision index (as a string) to a helpfulness score 1-10, where 10 = exactly right and 1 = misleading (e.g. {"1": 9, "2": 3}).

what_was_missing.description: A convention Metatron should have known for this task but didn't. Captured as a candidate for human curation.

missing_scope.description: Optional file path or area the missing convention applies to.
